title: onprem/airgap: vendor rke2 + flatcar packages into offline bundle; improve vendoring pipeline
author: Aditi Rao
description:
Motivation: Customers running Redwood Private in air-gapped environments requested official support for RKE2 and Flatcar OS as part of the offline installer. Previously we shipped an offline bundle that targeted a limited set of kube distros which caused additional manual steps for operations teams using Rancher/RKE2 or Flatcar images. This PR vendors the missing RKE2 runtime components and Flatcar-specific systemd overrides into the offline bundle and improves the vendoring pipeline to make future distro additions low-friction.

Summary of changes: vendors/rke2/ and vendors/flatcar/ directories added with prepackaged rke2 binaries, containerd + cri plugins, and Flatcar-specific kernel modules; helm/redwood-private chart updated to include conditional manifests and imagePullPolicy adjustments for airgap installs; installer/scripts/offline/generate_bundle.sh enhanced to accept --distro (rke2|k3s|eks|flatcar) and to verify image digests; terraform/modules/private updated to expose new offline_bundle artifacts; CI pipeline updated to run an offline bundle smoke test in a simulated air-gapped environment.

Testing and validation: local end-to-end installer run in a k3s VM and a KVM provisioned RKE2 node image; smoke tests passed in CI matrix for distros: k3s, rke2 with Flatcar, and rke2 with Ubuntu; manual verification of systemd unit overrides and containerd configuration on Flatcar; image digest verification added to prevent accidental mutable tag usage.

Upgrade notes: Existing customers upgrading an airgap bundle do not need to change configuration unless they explicitly opt-in to the new rke2 support. For clusters that switch from k3s to rke2 there is a documented migration path in the release notes (drain node, replace runtime, reapply manifests). Rolling upgrade instructions are included in the release notes field.

Rollback: Offline bundle generation is idempotent. If issues are detected after rollout, operators can revert to the previous offline bundle by restoring the old bundle tarball and re-running the installer with --bundle=previous.tar.gz. The installer will detect mismatched runtime manifests and abort with a clear error to avoid partial upgrades.

Checklist: - [x] Vendor rke2 binaries and supporting assets into offline bundle - [x] Add Flatcar support for systemd and kernel module loading - [x] Update helm chart to conditionally include distro-specific manifests - [x] Enhance bundle generator script with digest verification - [x] Add CI smoke test for offline bundle install in air-gapped sim - [x] Docs: update private installer README and release notes

Related: Linear ENG-4123 (airgap distro support), ENG-4190 (vendor pipeline improvements).

ci_summary: All CI checks passed after two reruns. Initial lint job failed due to long line in generate_bundle.sh and was fixed in c3d7a11. Offline-smoke job passed on rke2+flatcar node simulation. Artifacts (offline bundle tarball) uploaded to CI artifact store for release QA.
testing_notes: End-to-end manual installs done on: - KVM RKE2 + Flatcar node (provisioned with the generated bundle) - Local multipass k3s VM (sanity) Automated smoke tests run in CI for k3s, rke2(flatcar), rke2(ubuntu). Image digest verification ran during bundle creation and CI ensured no mutable tags remain.
release_notes: Added support for RKE2 and Flatcar OS in the offline installer bundle. Operators can now select --distro=rke2/flatcar when generating an air-gapped bundle. See docs/private/airgap-install.md for upgrade/migration steps.
backout_plan: Restore previous bundle tarball and re-run installer with --bundle=previous.tar.gz. If runtime mismatches detected, installer will abort and instruct manual rollback steps (drain, replace runtime, reapply manifests).
notes_for_release_manager: Bundle artifact: offline-bundle-redwood-2026-02-22-rke2-flatcar.tar.gz (CI artifact id: artif-20260222-35820). Ensure licenses file included in release payload. Recommend staged rollout to customers with canary subset and a 48h watch window for logs/metrics.
